name: Edo91 SEO Toolkit
author: edo91

sections.description:
Edo91 SEO Toolkit is a comprehensive, AI-powered SEO toolkit that brings professional-grade search engine optimization directly into your WordPress dashboard. No more switching between multiple tools — everything you need is right here.

What Makes It Special

  • AI-Powered Intelligence — Leverages advanced AI to analyze your content, detect AI-generated text, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • 15+ SEO Tools in One Plugin — From full site audits to per-page analysis, schema generation to redirect checking.
  • Beautiful Dashboard — An intuitive, modern interface with animated score gauges, health summaries, and trend tracking.
  • Per-Page Integration — Meta boxes in the classic editor and a dedicated Gutenberg sidebar panel.
  • Zero Configuration — Works out of the box. No API key required for basic usage.

Included Tools

  • SEO Dashboard — Full site audit with animated score gauge, health summary, and scan history.
  • Per-Page SEO Analysis — Scan any post or page directly from the editor.
  • AI Content Detection — Check if content is AI-generated with probability scores and signal analysis.
  • Schema Generator — Generate JSON-LD schema markup for FAQ, HowTo, Article, Product, and LocalBusiness.
  • Broken Link Checker — Detect broken links with HTTP status codes across any page.
  • Social Preview — Preview and edit how your content appears on Facebook and Twitter/X.
  • Content Quality Score — Readability analysis, keyword density, heading structure, and image alt coverage.
  • Image SEO — Missing alt text detection, lazy loading status, and format optimization.
  • Redirect Checker — Follow redirect chains, detect loops, and view hop-by-hop breakdowns.
  • Monthly Reports — Generate professional PDF reports with executive summaries and action items.
  • Internal Link Analysis — Find orphan pages and get linking suggestions.
  • Settings Panel — Configure API keys, scan frequency, enable/disable modules, and manage notifications.

Privacy & Security

  • All API requests are made securely via HTTPS.
  • No personal data is collected or shared.
  • Full nonce verification and capability checks on all AJAX endpoints.
  • Input sanitization and output escaping on all data.
  • GDPR-compliant — no tracking or cookies.

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API to provide advanced SEO analysis features. The following data may be sent to the service:

Edo91 SEO Audit API (ai-seo-audit-seven.vercel.app)
* What it is: The plugin connects to the Edo91 SEO Audit API for advanced analysis features including SEO audits, AI content detection, schema generation, broken link checking, social preview analysis, content scoring, image SEO analysis, redirect checking, and monthly report generation.
* What data is sent: The URL being analyzed and, optionally, page content for AI detection. An optional API key is sent in the Authorization header if configured.
* When it is sent: Only when a user with the manage_options capability manually triggers a scan or analysis from the WordPress admin dashboard.
* Terms of Service: https://ai-seo-audit-seven.vercel.app/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://ai-seo-audit-seven.vercel.app/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin as a zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the downloaded zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Click Activate.
  5. Find Edo91 SEO Toolkit in your admin menu.
  6. Click Scan Now to run your first site audit.
  7. (Optional) Add your API key in Settings for enhanced features.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

No. The plugin works out of the box for basic usage. An API key unlocks advanced features like AI content detection, schema generation, and detailed reports.

Where do I get an API key?

Visit ai-seo-audit-seven.vercel.app to register for a free API key.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. The plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal user data. All analysis is performed through secure API calls. No tracking cookies are used.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. Edo91 SEO Toolkit is an admin-only plugin. It does not load any scripts or styles on the frontend of your website.

Does it work with Gutenberg?

Yes. The plugin includes a dedicated Gutenberg sidebar panel with score display, scan button, and AI detection, in addition to the classic editor meta box.

What WordPress versions are supported?

The plugin requires WordPress 5.0 or higher and PHP 7.4 or higher. It has been tested up to WordPress 7.0.

Can I exclude certain pages from scanning?

Yes. Go to Edo91 SEO Toolkit > Settings and add URLs to the “Exclude Pages” field, one per line.

How often are automatic scans run?

You can configure the scan frequency in Settings: daily, weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly. The default is weekly.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin works with all custom post types, including WooCommerce products, and generates appropriate schema markup.

Can I generate reports for my clients?

Yes. The Monthly Report tool generates professional HTML reports with executive summaries, score trends, and actionable recommendations. These can be printed or saved as PDF.

What schema types are supported?

The Schema Generator supports Article, FAQ (FAQPage), HowTo, Product, and LocalBusiness schema types, with one-click insertion into your content.

Is the plugin translation-ready?

Yes. All strings are wrapped in translation functions and the plugin includes a text domain (edo91-seo-toolkit) for easy translation.
